codex
The change regresses `update_settings` by trying to read JSON from a file that has already been reopened in write mode. This makes the function fail for all callers and risks truncating the config file.

Review comment:

- [P1] Read the settings file before opening it in write mode — /tmp/rtk-codex-review-smoke/settings.py:8-10
  Opening `config_path` with `'w'` truncates the JSON file immediately and returns a write-only handle, so `json.load(fh)` now raises on every call to `update_settings` and can leave the settings file empty. Any caller that updates an existing config will fail and may lose the original contents.
